name: casual_slang_greeting
description: A new customer sends a casual, slang-heavy greeting. Tests that the AI handles informal language gracefully and still guides the conversation toward clarifying questions.

expected_behaviors.description: At least one assistant reply expected
Reply should acknowledge the casual greeting warmly
Reply should ask what kind of boards or material the customer needs

forbidden_patterns.description: No pricing or quotes in the greeting response

notes: The AI should match the customer's casual tone without being unprofessional. It should confirm that yes, boards are sold, then ask what type of material, size, and quantity the customer needs. No tools should be called yet since the request is too vague to quote.
